selection.criteria: 100ms provider-published sitemap was enumerated once and every listed v2 API-reference MDX source was fetched directly from the provider-owned documentation repository; no recursive documentation traversal was used.

connectors.evidence_source: Provider-published 100ms documentation sitemap and provider-owned https://github.com/100mslive/100ms-docs raw MDX API-reference sources.
connectors.counting_note: Provider sitemap enumerates 86 v2 API-reference pages. The direct MDX extraction preserves 73 unique documented operations: 33 GET reads and 40 POST/DELETE writes. V1 pages, endpoint-object pages, duplicate overview entries, and duplicate same-method/path badges are excluded under the immutable survey. One explicit POST /analytics/events/webhooks/replay curl example completes the documented 73-operation inventory where the provider page omits a visible request component.
connectors.selection_reason: direct provider source recovery after the primary sitemap parser and Postman/SDK route did not produce the complete immutable surface
